biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not an established required biomarker for cutaneous-type lip SCC; PD-1 inhibitors are used in advanced disease without a mandatory PD-L1 threshold

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Solar elastosis (chronic UV damage) in adjacent stroma

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Basal keratinocytes of vermillion border of lower lip (typical) or upper lip
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Ectoderm (surface ectoderm) — behaves like cutaneous SCC of sun-exposed skin
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Actinic cheilitis is the field-cancerization precursor lesion
